title: How to Half Double Crochet for Beginners #shorts
description:
Learn how to make the half double crochet stitch  - even if you're a beginner! I'll demonstrate a hdc slowly in this tutorial so you can see exactly what to do with your hook. Half double crochet is a simple crochet stitch that anyone can learn, so don't hesitate to try it for yourself!
